gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: 功能頁与鎖定
功能頁解鎖、纂刻的書与鎖定
解鎖去除附魔与纂刻的書，并保护充能中的母本
「去除附魔」与「纂刻的書」頁签起初处于鎖定狀態。将鼠标悬停在鎖定的頁签上，再按本章说明即可为当前玩家永久解鎖两頁：
[Cleanse] Put Depleted Tomes on nearby Chiseled Bookshelves and press the amber sacrifice button by the tabs. Sacrificing %s total unlocks Cleanse and grants an advancement.
[Tomes] Put Enchanted Books in at least %s nearby Chiseled Bookshelves (same scan as tome charging). The page unlocks and grants “How Much Longer...”.
【充能总览】「纂刻的書」頁会列出范围内每一本母本：剩余耐久、代际、恢復 +1 与恢復滿耐久的時間，以及距离下一档恢復速度還差多少書架。

[Locks] Select a book and lock it until +1, until full, or permanently. Locked books keep charging but cannot be removed or used anywhere. Early unlock costs %s XP level(s) + %s Cleansing Grit; timed locks release themselves.
一键鎖定与到期提醒
可用「全部锁至滿」一次鎖定所有充能中的書。限时锁会在書架上闪烁粒子，到期时提醒其主人。
